name: Adhbhut Infrastructure Limited
about: Adhbhut Infrastructure Limited engages in the real estate business in India. It is involved in the development and letting of buildings on lease; and management of real estate properties in the residential, commercial, and retail sectors. The company was formerly known as Adhbhut Industrial Resources Limited and changed its name to Adhbhut Infrastructure Limited. Adhbhut Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Gurugram, India.
